Class Main

java.lang.Object
com.realestate.management.Main
public class Main extends Object
Entry point and user interface of the real estate developer management system.

Provides a complete console-based menu system to interact with all features of the application. All input/output is handled through a shared Scanner instance.

Author:
Juan Carlos Alfaro Jiménez

    • main

      args - Command-line arguments (not used).

    • mainMenu

      private static void mainMenu()
      Displays and drives the main menu loop.

    • readInteger

      public static int readInteger()
      Safely reads an integer from the console.

      Clears the input buffer after reading. If the input is not a valid integer, prints an error, clears the buffer, and returns -1.

      Returns:
      The integer entered by the user, or -1 on invalid input.

    • readDouble

      public static double readDouble()
      Safely reads a decimal number from the console.

      Clears the input buffer after reading. If the input is not a valid double, prints an error, clears the buffer, and returns -1.0.

      Returns:
      The double entered by the user, or -1.0 on invalid input.

    • readString

      public static String readString()
      Reads a non-empty string from the console.

      Keeps prompting the user until a non-blank line is entered.

      Returns:
      The validated non-empty string entered by the user.

    • selectBuilding

      private static int selectBuilding()
      Prompts the user to select an existing building by index.

      Lists all registered buildings and returns the selected 0-based index. Returns -1 if no buildings are registered.

      Returns:
      The 0-based building index selected by the user, or -1 if none exist.

    • viewApartmentStatus

      private static void viewApartmentStatus()
      Prompts the user to select a building and displays its apartment status grid.

    • sellReserveMenu

      private static void sellReserveMenu()
      Submenu that allows the user to either sell or reserve an apartment.

      The user selects the building, floor, door, buyer DNI, and quality tier. Then delegates to Developer.sellApartment(int, int, int, java.lang.String, com.realestate.management.model.Apartment.Quality) or Developer.reserveApartment(int, int, int, java.lang.String, com.realestate.management.model.Apartment.Quality).

    • selectQuality

      private static Apartment.Quality selectQuality()
      Prompts the user to select a quality tier from the available options.
      Returns:
      The selected Apartment.Quality, or null on invalid input.

    • joinApartments

      private static void joinApartments()
      Guides the user through joining two contiguous apartments on the same floor.

      The user selects the building, floor, two adjacent door numbers, buyer DNI, and quality tier. Delegates to Building.joinApartments(int, int, int, java.lang.String, com.realestate.management.model.Apartment.Quality).

    • joinStorage

      private static void joinStorage()
      Guides the user through joining two contiguous storage units.

      Delegates fully to Building.joinStorage(int, int, java.lang.String), which handles the merge and left-shift internally.
